card.name: Partway through medical terms like amenorrhea
card.fires_on: The middle of long medical words, most often the 'orr' in amenorrhea and oligomenorrhea. It also fires on 'development' in 'development program' and on 'os' in immunosuppression.

modes.label: Amenorrhea spelling
modes.description: The 'orr' piece inside amenorrhea or oligomenorrhea in menstrual side-effect text.
modes.example: Amenorrhea and Oligomenorrhea Females who are not pregnant and use ANNOVERA may experience amen<<orr>>hea.

modes.label: The word development
modes.description: 'development' in phrases about drug development programs or antibody development.
modes.example: Such events have not been reported for PONVORY-treated patients in the<< development>> program.

modes.label: Other mid-word or number pieces
modes.description: Pieces inside other medical words or inside numbers, such as immunosuppression or a decimal point.
modes.example: is expected to increase the risk of immun<<os>>uppression.
